issues: Scrambled/merged list structure: in Article 1 items 16–17 and 23–24 are combined into single lines, obscuring separate numbered items.
Scrambled/merged list structure in Article 2: lettered points a–b are on one line and 'and f' is merged as 'andf'.
Scrambled/merged list structure in Article 3: lettered points b–c and d–e are merged into single lines ('...; c.' and '...; ande.').
Scrambled/merged list structure in Article 4: lettered points i–k are merged into one line ('...; j.' and 'andk.').
Meaning drift: "Dinas" translated as "Agency"; in this context it should be "Service/Department" (a local government department).
Minor meaning drift/terminology: "Perempuan Korban" should be rendered as "Female Victims" (women who are victims), not "Women Victims" (can read as victims who are women, but less standard/legal).
Scrambled/merged list markers in Article 5: items d and e are combined on one line in the translation, whereas the original has separate items d. and e.
Scrambled/merged list markers in Article 7: items a, b, and c are combined on one line in the translation, whereas the original has separate items a., b., and c.
Scrambled/merged list markers in Article 8(1): items g and h are combined on one line in the translation, whereas the original has separate items g. and h.
Scrambled/merged list markers in Article 8(1): items j and k are combined on one line in the translation, whereas the original has separate items j. and k.
Scrambled/merged list markers in Article 8(1): items m and n are combined on one line in the translation, whereas the original has separate items m. and n.
Scrambled/merged list markers in Article 8(1): items n and o are combined on one line in the translation, whereas the original has separate items n. and o.
Scrambled/merged list markers in Article 8(2): item (3) is incorrectly appended to item n. instead of being a separate numbered item "3."
Meaning drift in Article 9: "dikoordinasikan oleh Dinas" is translated as "coordinated by the Agency"; it should be "coordinated by the Department/Service (Dinas)" (not a generic agency).

Broken/scrambled list marker in Article 5: original has item "h." then "i." but translation inserts "and" as a separate line, risking downstream list-boundary parsing; should keep markers a–i cleanly.

Minor meaning drift/terminology: "Peraturan Wali Kota" should be rendered as "Mayor Regulation" or "Mayor's Regulation" consistently; current "a Mayor Regulation" is acceptable but better as definite form "Mayor Regulation" (no article) to match a specific instrument name.

Scrambled/incorrect list and numbering structure in Article 15: item (2) is embedded mid-sentence after letter g, and item (3) is mislabeled as '3.' instead of '(3)'; lettered subitems a–g are run together with missing line breaks.
Scrambled/incorrect list and numbering structure in Article 17(2): letter markers are merged ('d. counseling;ande. ...') and should be separate items d and e.
Scrambled/incorrect list and numbering structure in Article 18(1): 'and - 12 -j.' is merged into item i; letter j should be a separate item.
Scrambled/incorrect list and numbering structure in Article 19(1): letter markers are merged ('andk.') and should be separate item k.

Scrambled/incorrect list and numbering structure in Article 23(2), 23(3), and 23(5): letter markers are merged ('and g', 'andb', 'andg') and paragraph (5) is not properly marked as '(5)' on its own line.

Meaning drift/terminology: 'Peraturan Wali Kota' should be rendered as 'Mayor Regulation' (not 'Mayor Regulation' preceded by 'the'); and 'Dinas' is better as 'Department/Agency'—kept as 'Agency' but structure corrected to match original markers.
Scrambled/incorrect numbering in Article 15: original has items (1), (2), and 3., but translation contains stray "11 -" and uses (3) instead of "3."
Leftover page/formatting artifacts included as standalone text ("11 -", "and - 12 -", "13 -", "14 -") which are not part of the legal text and disrupt structure
Meaning drift in Article 18(2): "Dinas" translated as "the Agency" (should be "the Service/Department"), and responsibility phrasing should reflect "menjadi tanggung jawab"
Minor meaning drift/wording in Article 25(2): "terpadu dan terintegrasi" rendered as "integrated and integrated" (should be "integrated and interconnected/fully integrated")

Scrambled/merged list structure: in Article 26 the markers 'a.' and 'b.' are merged into one line; in Article 30 and Article 32 lettered items are run together and not consistently separated, risking boundary-based parsing errors.
List/numbering marker missing/incorrect: Article 32 paragraph (3) is not formatted as a separate numbered item; it appears inline as '(3)' after paragraph (2).

Minor meaning/terminology drift: 'Dinas' is translated as 'the Agency' without indicating it is the relevant Service/Department; keep consistent as 'the Service (Dinas)' to preserve the legal referent.
Broken/scrambled list structure in Article 26: original has 'a. UPT;danb. PPT.' but translation splits/normalizes and adds 'and' on a new line; needs to preserve list markers and order exactly.
Meaning drift in Article 30 letter o: translated as 'integrated and integrated' instead of 'terpadu dan terintegrasi' (should be 'integrated and interconnected/fully integrated').

Meaning drift in Article 33(1): translation implies only 'media that implement women's protection' receive awards; original includes 'komunitas, media' as separate recipients (both communities and media).
Leftover non-legal commentary at the end: "This excerpt sits under: CHAPTER XIII > CLOSING PROVISIONS" is not part of the original text and must be removed.
